subject: Quick alternative for the visit
text:
Sorry to shoot this over so quick, but I was thinking about the campus visit and the parking situation looked rough from our side. If the buses get delayed again, maybe swap the library stop for the smaller workshop room by the north entrance. It's tighter, yet everyone can still see the archival samples without crowding, and the walk from the lot is nearly half what we had last term.

I'd also suggest letting students choose whether they want the extra reading before or after; the current handout is fine, but the timeline is tight for folks working mornings. If you're stuck on logistics, the AV cart in that room has the simpler cord set, which usually saves ten minutes.

The alternative also leaves us less exposed if rain hits. We can spread the activity across the counter instead of dragging everyone down the stairs, and that feels easier on the teaching assistants. Maybe put one volunteer at the elevator and one near the samples; that way nobody's wandering. If the professor prefers keeping the main lobby stop, the only fix I'd make is shifting coffee to after, because the first group always needs bathroom breaks and that's where the bottleneck starts.

No rush on this; I can help load materials if you'd rather not send someone else. Just wanted to flag the alternative while it's fresh. Happy to test it tomorrow.
